text:
Alex: quick ping for reviews on https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/compare/pr/1789 — tiny rename + formatting nits, CI failing on import order. planning to merge by EOD if no blockers :hourglass_flowing_sand:
Priya: link — thanks, looking now. do we need a changelog entry?
Alex: no user-facing changes, just internal naming and `isort`/format fixes. no changelog needed.
Jordan: saw the CI error — `pkg/runtime/exec.go` has mixed stdlib + external imports. run `isort --profile black` or `goimports` depending on language.
Sam: also `gofmt -s` will tidy a couple of leftovers in `runtime/serve.go`. small patch.
Mia: there's one test flake in `tests/serve/test_cache.py` that fails on my machine when imports get reordered — I think a race in setup. I can push a tiny fix, or we can mark the test as flaky in this PR and follow up.
Alex: thanks — if it's quick can you push the test fix here, @Mia? otherwise I'll mark and open a follow-up.
Mia: pushing now, will rerun CI.
CI-Bot: Build queued for PR #1789 — checks: fmt, lint, unit-tests.
Jordan: small naming nit: variable `ctxID` -> `requestID` (consistency with other files). not blocking but prefer to fix before merge.
Alex: ok I'll rename `ctxID` -> `requestID` in the two spots and run format.
Priya: lgtm from me once CI is green.
Sam: +1 on the rename, please squash commits into one tidy commit message like "refactor: rename ctxID -> requestID; run format"
Alex: will do squash + force-push. aiming to merge at 18:00 PT if CI passes.
CI-Bot: fmt passed. lint failed: import-order in `pkg/runtime/exec.go` (error: groups not separated).
Alex: re-running `isort` locally and will push.
Mia: tests passed for me after the small setup fix, good to go.
Alex: pushed fixes (isort + rename + test tweak). CI rerunning.
Priya: approved. :white_check_mark:
Jordan: approved. :+1:
CI-Bot: All checks passed for PR #1789.
Alex: merging now. thanks everyone for the quick turnaround :rocket:
Sam: nice - thanks for driving this, Alex.
Mia: nice work!
Alex: noted for follow-up: add a quick note to the dev-qa doc about the test setup flakiness so folks know the workaround.
